verdicts.citation: SPEC.md 4 T10 'Limits' (unlabelled; T10's only [D] is on its Presets bullet): 'while it is being turned at most 8000 are drawn'. SPEC.md 5.6 caps row 'Edges drawn (T10) | 70000 at rest; 8000 while turning' (not [D]). RED-TEAM-COMMON 2: 'a specific way in which a test, a check or a claim proves less than it says' is a finding. RT-10 lens attack 33: 'the limits ... each have a test', 'Failure: as attack 1'. These passages support the finding's expected.
verdicts.evidence: Read at b9b8504: SPEC 4 T10 in full, 4.0, 5.6, 7.7, 9.1, 9.2 and 2.14. T10 is phase 4 (the heading 'T10. Geometry Studio (phase 4)' and the 4 table), and the gate is G4. T10.test.ts:329 'the turning subset has at most 8000 edges...' calls drawPicture with its own turning flag. T10GeometryStudio.svelte:872 passes `turning: isTurning`. No e2e spec under site/tests/e2e turns a picture above 8000 edges. A git grep for turning, edgesTurning and edgesDrawn finds only T10.spec 'turning by keys and buttons' on A3 (no edge count) and at-rest edgesDrawn checks in T10.spec and M7.spec. The lens's patch (91de6bb:redteam/mutations/t10-turning-cap-removed.patch) changes only that one argument to `turning: false`. DECISIONS.md 'P4-A2: the caps while turning' and 'P4-A3: the turning subset' record how the 8000 are chosen. They do not record any choice to test the cap only at drawPicture level. gate-G4.md (report commit 4e3e839, which names b9b8504 as its gate commit) has no open item on this. No merge-P4-redteam report exists on disk, and no '// regression' test covers this case. Partial argument tried: SPEC 7.7's Components row ('each tool's acceptance criteria of section 4'), 9.2 and the G4 cell require tests only for the Acceptance paragraph, which does not name the turning cap. The plan's P4-A3 checklist item '5.9 turning cap' asks only for the unit test that exists. These set a minimum. None of them says a stated cap may go unguarded at the tool.
verdicts.reason: not refuted: R1 failed: no sentence of 4 T10, 5.6, 7.7 or 9.2 permits the tool's turning cap to go unguarded; 7.7 and 9.2 only set the minimum (the acceptance criteria). R2 failed: the finding reads the Limits bullet, the 5.6 row and lens attack 33 correctly, and the unit test guards drawPicture, not the component. R3 failed: T10 is phase 4 at G4. R4 does not apply, since no oracle value is involved. R5 failed: the Limits bullet and the 5.6 table carry no [D], and DECISIONS.md records how the 8000 are chosen but no choice about testing. R6 failed: there is no gate-G4 item, earlier round or regression test. Severity is left as claimed because the rubric is ambiguous here. The cap is present at the gate, so the major wording ('a cap ... missing') does not literally fit. The claim falls between blocker ('a test suite that passes while the behaviour is absent') and minor ('a test that could be stronger'). Lens attack 33 grades this case as attack 1. The lens itself rated the identical pattern in P4-RT-10-02 minor.

verdicts.citation: SPEC.md 4 T10 'Make uniform (display only)': 'the tool replaces the start by the real vector with a_i=c/sqrt(d_i) on the ringed nodes and replays those words in floating point (applyWordFloat)'. SPEC.md 2.14 Edge lengths: the option itself is [D]; '2 d_i a_i^2' is [V]. SPEC.md 3 M7 beat 5 and figure 5. RED-TEAM-COMMON 2 and 4 (minor: 'a test that could be stronger without being wrong'). The passages support the finding's expected.
verdicts.evidence: At b9b8504 the component computes ys with replayVertices only when uniformOn (T10GeometryStudio.svelte:251-256). It computes `lengths` from baseEdgeLengths on uniformStart or the integer start (:275), never from ys. The component never calls drawnOf (git grep). T10.test.ts:358 checks drawnOf. T10.spec.ts:247 and M7.spec.ts:503-512 assert only uniform on/off, edgeLengths data-count 2 then 1, and the vertex and edge counts. None of them reads the drawn points. The lens's patch (91de6bb:redteam/mutations/t10-uniform-not-drawn.patch) changes only `positions` in ys, so every one of these assertions is unaffected. DECISIONS.md 'P4-A3: make uniform' records c (the largest ringed integer), off by default and not a link field. Its line 'The lengths shown are measured on the drawn coordinates y = E C^-1 a' describes the base edges of the start vector and does not waive a test of the drawing. R5 tried: 2.14's [D] covers offering make uniform as a floating-point display option, which the build does. It does not cover testing it. 4.0 Test hooks ('Browser tests read these hooks and the live region, and nothing else') limits how a browser test reads output; it does not exempt a stated behaviour from testing. A Vitest test of the component path, or a data-out, is open to the builders. gate-G4.md has no item on this, there is no earlier phase 4 round, and no regression test covers it.
verdicts.reason: not refuted: R1 failed: no sentence permits the drawing to ignore make uniform or to go untested. 7.7 sets the minimum (the acceptance criteria), and 4.0 Test hooks limits only how browser tests read output. R2 failed: the finding reads 4 T10 Make uniform and M7 beat 5 correctly, and the existing tests check reported lengths, not the drawn points. R3 failed: T10 and M7 are phase 4 at G4. R4 does not apply, since no oracle value is involved. R5 failed: the [D] of 2.14 covers offering the display option, not its testing, and P4-A3's record waives nothing. R6 failed: there is no gate-G4 item, earlier round or regression test. Minor is the rubric's level: the edgeLengths checks are correct but could be stronger.

verdicts.citation: build-plan/README.md 3.2: 'DECISIONS.md is written only by MERGE and GATE, from fragments that build agents leave in decisions/<agent-id>.md'. build-plan/agents/MERGE.md checklist: 'Every fragment of the stage folded verbatim under the stage heading' (README 3.2, 6; SPEC.md 9.3). MERGE.md never-list: 'Reword, shorten or correct a decisions fragment while folding it.' COMMON.md 5.1: 'one dated entry per decision', with the '## <date> <agent>: <title>' heading. RT-10 attack 18: 'every fragment of the phase folded into DECISIONS.md'. These support the finding's expected.
verdicts.evidence: At b9b8504, decisions/RT-FIX-P3-board-a11y.md line 1 is '## 2026-10-17 RT-FIX-P3-board-a11y: a frozen board stays one tab stop (P3-RT-05-02)'. In DECISIONS.md (2936 lines), line 2523 is the heading 'RT-FIX-P3-garden-follow: followers keep the followed play (P3-RT-04-04)', line 2524 is its body, and line 2526 is the board-a11y body ('Decision: after hydration the `disabled` prop of `Board.svelte` ...') with no heading of its own. Line 2528 holds the fragment's second heading. A grep for 'a frozen board stays one tab stop' finds only line 2818, inside another entry that cites the entry by that title. The gate commit's subject reads 'MERGE: red-team round 1 residual fixes, fragments folded'. Not a [D] item, not a section 10 default, and not a later phase (the fold is a G4 merge). gate-G4.md section 10 records the RT-FIX-P3 fragments as folded and notes no exception. The later commit 6568ed7 'MERGE: restore the lost heading of RT-FIX-P3-board-a11y's first entry (P4-RT-10-03)' on claude/session-6a181f60-hzzoud comes after the finding, so it confirms the defect rather than recording it earlier (R6).
verdicts.reason: not refuted: R1 failed: MERGE.md requires a verbatim fold and forbids correcting a fragment, so nothing permits dropping a heading. R2 failed: the finding reads README 3.2 and attack 18 correctly, and DECISIONS.md:2526 shows the body filed under the garden-follow heading. R3 failed: the fold belongs to the G4 commit. R4 does not apply. R5 failed: it is not a [D] choice or a recorded default. R6 failed: the only record is MERGE's post-gate fix 6568ed7, made in answer to this finding. Minor fits the rubric's 'wording, a name': the decision text is present and only its heading, and so its attribution, is lost.
